title: Dependency Sort
description: Sorts directed dependencies into an order and concurrently runnable batches. An edge [a,b] means a must precede b. Optional nodes include isolated tasks; edge endpoints are added automatically. IDs are case-sensitive, nonempty strings preserved verbatim. Duplicate nodes and edges are ignored. Initial roots follow node discovery order (explicit nodes first, then edge endpoints); later batches follow root traversal and outgoing edge input order. Cycles return valid:false, error:CYCLE, partialOrder, partialBatches, and blocked nodes (cycle members AND their downstream dependents, not necessarily all in a cycle). Limits: 10000 distinct nodes, 50000 edges, 256 UTF-16 units per ID.
